instruction: Candid medium shot of an indoor celebration. In the center, the man in the gray shirt (R1) and the man with curly hair (R8) in a red polo shirt are locked in a warm embrace, with the curly-haired man smiling. To the right, the man with glasses (R4) in a white sweatshirt stands watching them with a happy expression. The man in the brown shirt (R5) is partially visible in the background. The room is decorated with balloons and bunting under bright, soft light.

R4 watches R1 and R8 rather than joining the embrace
R5 is partially visible in the background rather than being the central contact partner

the setting is an indoor celebration
